title: Scales and Ponds ABC
hook: Amphibian or reptile? Check more than the shape.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D reptile-and-amphibian storybook, pond greens and warm stones, non-scary creatures, clean silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child classifying herps by body and life-history traits
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written taxonomy and habitat; venomous/dangerous species image-only
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: class cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft water-plop plus one dry woodblock scale-click after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft water-plop plus one dry woodblock scale-click after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Scales and Ponds ABC a reptile-versus-amphibian comparison built around skin, eggs, life cycle, habitat and breathing, rather than mixing every herp into one pond rhyme.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sorts pond-edge animals into amphibian and reptile columns while allowing semi-aquatic reptiles to cross the water edge.
